title: Why did posting a channel reply with broadcast fail, and why did hot reload not fix it?
summary: The owner's direct question was answered: pnpm start executes compiled server/dist/server.js without a watcher, so it keeps its loaded schema until rebuilt and restarted. The reported schema/package fix is in the current tree and its regression test rejects broadcast:true. The associated broader update-flow work remains open, with no evidence this live process was restarted or that the install/update flow now restarts safely.
nextAction: Product Development Lead owns the install experience and its open restart-mechanism subtask; complete and verify safe restart behavior in the update flow, then verify the running app loads the rebuilt code. Do not restart the live process as part of this review.
evidence: Thread replies post_01a0e8c3-ccf8-7560-a436-81961db2ab07 and post_01a0e8c5-79c0-777b-b190-943e5fd475ab explain stale compiled server/dist under pnpm start and recommend rebuild + restart.
HEAD ef32838 removes channel broadcast option; server/src/buddies/routes.ts and server/dist/buddies/routes.js both use z.literal(false).default(false).
server/test/buddies-v2.test.ts test 'owner channel replies stay in threads and reject old broadcast requests' covers rejection and normal thread-only reply behavior.

Current task buddy_project_d5d94e0e-4990-4277-bafc-73a7c6bb2a6d remains in_progress; child todo_7bb1fee9-cea0-4eb1-979d-18c5a6f05213 ('Complete the update flow... Needs a restart mechanism') remains open.
limitations: Read-only review; no tests or runtime restart performed. Shared worktree is dirty, so current working-tree source/test observations are not treated as a verified clean commit; commit ef32838's route source and regression test are integrated at HEAD, but dist is generated/dirty-tree evidence and live runtime state was not checked.
